title: Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships — One Lounge Membership per Person
content:
**Clause.** A person may hold only one Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships lounge membership; a new membership is not opened while the customer has one in pending, active or grace status, and a higher membership is reached by upgrade instead.

The limit is 1 lounge membership per customer. Whether a customer already holds one is read from the company's own membership records for that customer — the status recorded on each lounge membership in the customer's name — and is judged before a new membership is opened.

## Status of an existing membership and its effect on opening a new one

| Status recorded on the customer's existing lounge membership | May a new lounge membership be opened for the customer? |
|---|---|
| Pending | No |
| Active | No |
| Grace | No |

A customer who holds a membership in any of these three statuses and wants a higher membership in the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships range reaches it by upgrading the membership already held, not by opening a second one.

## Points of judgement

- **What is counted.** Lounge memberships recorded against the same customer. A membership in pending status counts as held, even though it has not yet started.
- **Which statuses bar a new membership.** Pending, active and grace. A membership in grace — past its renewal date without renewal dues paid — still counts as held.
- **Illustration (hypothetical).** A customer's records show one Summit Club Essential membership in active status. A request to open a Summit Club Individual membership for that customer does not lead to a second membership being opened; the higher membership is reached by upgrade instead.
